name: Iris Clothings Ltd
about: IRIS Clothings Limited, incorporated in 1956, is engaged in designing, manufacturing, branding and selling garments for kids. [1]Iris Clothings Limited is a fast-growing readymade garment company and is engaged in designing, manufacturing, branding and selling garments for kids wear under the brand name DOREME in India. It produces a broad range of unique apparels for infants, toddlers and junior boys and girls.
keyPoints:
Business Profile[1]
Founded in 1956, Iris Clothings Limited is a kids' apparel company that designs, manufactures, and markets ready-made garments under the "DOREME" brand. Catering to infants, toddlers, and junior boys and girls, they offer affordable, high-quality indoor and outdoor clothing for domestic and international markets.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -9.54%
